createHouse.intro: You land as a metic in the city that welcomes you. Give your oikos a name and a blazon.

agora.bestAsk: Bought at once: sellers offer {{quantity}} × {{good}} at {{price}}.

income.title: Income statement
income.intro: On a cash basis: income or an expense counts on the day money changes hands; an expense is negative. A game day starts at the daily close. Running costs are upkeep, wages, lodging, transport and rents paid; acquisitions and disposals cover sites, ships and properties.
income.empty: No money moved over these periods.

city.intro: The city's inhabitants buy at the agora. At each daily close, the population grows if its vital needs were well enough covered the day before; otherwise some of them emigrate.

steward.title: Steward
steward.noPost: Your seat has no steward post.
steward.pitch: A steward follows the rules you give, without you. The wage, {{cost}} a day, is paid at the close; unpaid, nothing is done.
steward.hireDone: {{name}} enters your service. The stewardship starts at the next close, which pays the wage.
steward.active: {{name}} follows the rules: the last close paid the wage.
steward.hired: {{name}} takes office at the next close, which will pay the wage (hired on {{date}}).
steward.unpaid: {{name}}'s wage has been unpaid since {{date}}: nothing is done until a close pays it.
steward.noRule: No rules: the steward does nothing.

steward.invalid: Rule {{n}} is incomplete, out of bounds or duplicated.

instruction.title: Instruction
instruction.label: Your instruction to {{name}}, in your own words
instruction.hint: For example: “sell the oil above 12 drachmas, otherwise keep it”. Write prices and quantities in digits, each price whole and in a single unit (obols or drachmas); you will approve the proposed rules.
instruction.sent: {{name}} is studying your instruction: the proposal follows shortly.
instruction.pending: {{name}} is studying this instruction; the proposal arrives shortly.
instruction.proposed: Rules proposed by {{name}}, and what each would do now:

rules.sell_one: Sell {{good}} at {{price}} a unit or more, keeping {{count}} unit
rules.sell_other: Sell {{good}} at {{price}} a unit or more, keeping {{count}} units
rules.buy_one: Buy back {{good}} at {{price}} a unit or less, up to {{count}} unit in stock
rules.buy_other: Buy back {{good}} at {{price}} a unit or less, up to {{count}} units in stock

refusals.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI is off for now: {{name}} cannot translate your instruction. Give the rules with the form.
refusals.INVALID_PROPOSAL: {{name}} could not turn this instruction into valid rules. Rephrase it, or give the rules with the form.
refusals.OUT_OF_GRAMMAR: {{name}} can harvest, sell and buy back, nothing else: this instruction asks for something else.
refusals.AMBIGUOUS: This instruction is ambiguous: it lacks a good, a price or a quantity written in digits, or a price is not whole in a single unit (not “12.5 drachmas” nor “1 drachma 3 obols”). Make it precise, or give the rules with the form.

instruction.answered: {{name}} answered your instruction: open “Instruction” to accept or edit the proposal.
